repair.stem: Questions 20 to 22 refer to a graph of Adam and his fiancée's combined monthly salaries (in thousands of dollars) during 2019: Jan 2, Feb 3, Mar 2, Apr 8, May 6, Jun 4, Jul 2, Aug 1, Sep 11, Oct 9, Nov 3, Dec 6. — During September, Adam worked 15 hours per day, while his fiancée worked 11 hours per day. Knowing that each one of them took 4 days off that month, and his fiancée was getting paid USD 10.7 per hour, how much was Adam approximately getting paid per hour?
repair.explanation: Each worked 26 days. His fiancée earned 26 × 11 × 10.7 = USD 3,060.20. Adam's hourly rate was (11,000 − 3,060.20)/(26 × 15) ≈ USD 20.36, closest to USD 20.4.
